newsitem.title: USA: More than 20,000 homes damaged in Calif. floods.
newsitem.headline: More than 20,000 homes damaged in Calif. floods.

text.p: More than 20,000 homes were damaged or destroyed by floods in California during Janaury, a state agency said Thursday.
The California Office of Emergency Services said 20,796 homes were damaged or destroyed as well as 2,967 mobile homes and 1,935 businesses.

Forty-six of the state's 58 counties have been declared federal disaster areas because of severe floods earlier this month that killed 10 people and inundated communities and wide areas of farmland in central and northern California.
The Office of Emergency Services did not place a value on the damage, but has previously estimated damage from the floods at more than $1.5 billion.
The winter storms of 1995, California's most damaging flood disaster in history, caused $1.8 billion in damage.
